headline: A’s +29.91% surge on an 8.4σ volume spike is the standout, while PF’s -20.00% move follows SET’s temporary trading resumption after a suspension exceeding three months.
market_take: The coverage group is split, with sharp downside in EMC (-50.00%) and KC (-50.00%) alongside gains led by A (+29.91%), DCON (+7.14%), PPPM (+6.67%) and ITD (+6.06%). Trading activity was unusually elevated across several names, including A at 8.4σ, SCGD at 20.8σ and MBK at 4.6σ versus their 20-day averages. Filings centered on A5 and KUN results, BR, VNG and MALEE earnings, PF’s trading status and ESTAR’s CFO change.

sector_notes.note: A rose 29.91% on an 8.4σ volume spike and +29.91% open gap, while PF fell 20.00% after SET temporarily allowed trading following a suspension of over three months. JCK rose 5.88% with a matching open-gap alert, but J fell 8.11%.
EMC dropped 50.00% on a 0.12 volume ratio, while SQ fell 5.88% on an open-gap alert and ITD gained 6.06%. APCS recorded a 5.7σ volume spike, and PRG also showed elevated activity.
GEL fell 25.00% on a 0.06 volume ratio, whereas DCON gained 7.14% on 0.03 volume. SCGD registered the largest unusual-volume reading at 20.8σ, with DCC at 3.6σ.
CHAO rose 4.17% on 3.93× normal volume and a 4.4σ volume spike. BR filed reviewed Q3 financial statements and related earnings disclosures, while MALEE also published revised reviewed Q3 results.
PPPM rose 6.67% to 0.32 on a 0.83 volume ratio.
